cards.question: What is the definition of variable scope in C?
cards.answer: The region of source code text where an identifier is visible and can be referenced by the compiler.

cards.question: What is the difference between block scope and file scope in C?
cards.answer: Block scope limits an identifier visibility to within the enclosing {} braces, whereas file scope makes an identifier visible from its declaration point to the end of the translation unit.

cards.question: What happens when an inner block declares a variable with the same identifier as an outer block or global variable in C?
cards.answer: The inner declaration shadows (hides) the outer variable within that block scope; compiler flag -Wshadow warns about this.
